migration.executionAuthority: W05 bound to admitted D1-02 UUID only
preconditions: W05-to-D1-02 physical binding evidence is present for the exact deployment SHA.
No authoritative social_follow_relationships table exists with conflicting schema.
The migration artifact hash is recorded before execution.
postconditions: social_follow_relationships exists with the contracted columns and primary key.
The active relation uniqueness constraint exists on (follower_user_id, target_user_id).
The follower pagination index exists on (follower_user_id, created_at).
The target pagination index exists on (target_user_id, created_at).
No cross-D1 physical foreign key is introduced.
Applied migration version is observable in the target database migration ledger.
forbidden: DROP TABLE social_follow_relationships as a routine rollback.
ALTER or rename contracted columns without a new admitted contract.
Add follower/following counters as authoritative columns.
Add a Payload Collection for Follow.
Add a cross-D1 foreign key to ENT-USER.
Create a second authoritative Follow table in another D1 domain.
Execute against a database UUID other than the admitted D1-02 UUID.
Claim migration success from planned, static, or local-only validation.

evidenceRequirements: exact source SHA used for deployment
migration artifact path and content hash
applied migration version from the target D1 migration ledger
schema inspection proving columns, nullability and primary key
Evidence Registry record bound to the execution SHA
promotionRule: Remain CONTRACTED_NOT_VERIFIED until the physical binding, versioned migration artifact and executed D1 schema evidence all pass their respective gates.
nonGoals: This contract does not execute a migration.
This contract does not deploy a Worker.
This contract does not add W05 runtime handlers.
This contract does not promote SOCIAL-001 to GREEN.
This contract does not promote SOCIAL-002 followers/following queries.
